notes.title: Update v.0.3.486
notes.notes:
Update v.0.3.486

Changes:
*) Now after loading saves the game will not be re-saved again, which was the case before
*) Now the dialogue panels of units will not overlap each other
*) Completely switched to a new save system (the old ones will not work)!!!
*) Now the Overground Lamp building will not have an inventory
*) In the game settings, the FPS limit has moved to the Graphics tab
*) The unit preview scene in the inventory has been slightly optimized
*) Now the mining beam of the tool will correctly hit the props when mining or resolving
*) The prop colliders have been updated, which has slightly increased the performance when working with them
*) Now when you click on the header of a window that can be moved, it will automatically move to the foreground, on top of all other windows
*) Updated the visual of the item separation window
*) The Add all fuel button has been removed if there is only one resource in the inventory
*) The Gas Storage, Marketplace, Steam Energy, Teleport, Gas Purification, Ore Purification technologies have been made more expensive
*) The inventory size of the Component Factory building has been reduced from 6x4 to 5x4
*) Now Energy cells will be highlighted when fully charged (provided that they remain in the charging slot)
*) Now the Accumulation Station building can be visually seen on the model how many charging slots are currently occupied
*) Now the icons when dragged in the inventory will be the same size as the main ones
*) Now it will be impossible to remove the inventory expansion module from the building
*) The visual of the panel with information about the module has been corrected
*) The visual of the item tooltip has been corrected
*) The size of the Sorting Window has been increased from 10x10 to 10x20
*) Optimized the creation of inventory cells, now they load a little faster
*) It will no longer be possible to enter special characters when editing the preset name
*) The number of characters in the name has been limited to 15
*) The animation of the destruction of trees and rocks has been updated
*) Now the icon of an item that is being dismantled will darken and become inactive
*) The cost has been increased and production time of some complex components
*) Now the Sawmill will consume electricity when planting vegetation
*) The detection radius of buried containers has been reduced from 25 units to 15
*) Now scanning buried containers will take some time
*) Now when starting the game, the music volume will gradually increase
*) Now when you click on the information panel "Take resources from the landing shuttle" the building will be highlighted
*) Now when units take resources from the building, they will also place them in the Forward compartment if the main one is full
*) Now when saving the world manually through the settings window, a special indicator will appear that the world is being saved. It will be clearer when saving is in progress
*) Now when disassembling modules or containers, nested items will also be taken into account
*) Now in the Disassembly window, new items will try to stack, and not multiply throughout the window
*) It will now be impossible to disassemble a container item that is in the equipped state (for example, the Rear Compartment of a unit). In order to disassemble it, you will first need to remove it
*) Now the laser beam will be synchronized with the animation of the tool movement during mining
*) Now the dialog panel that appears above the unit will have a time indicator in the form of a slider, after which this panel will close
*) Hidden unavailable technologies in the information panel in the Technology window
*) Changed the recipe for building a Crusher
*) Optimized the window with a list of changes
*) Now in Wikipedia, in the Cleaning section, recipes that can be obtained from this resource will also be shown
*) Now in the tips for building, information about energy consumption or production will be duplicated
*) Optimized the chassis animation - it will not play when the camera is at maximum zoom
*) Now the animation for building a Network Tower will play when at least one network element is connected to it
*) Now Energy Cells of tools can be charged in the Energy Storage Station

Added:
*) Added a new starting task - Resource extraction
*) Added a hint to the item tooltip that the module cannot be removed from the building
*) Added the ability to edit the unit name in the Building window, to do this, click on the name and editing will become available
*) Added Brightness and Gamma settings
*) Added drawing of the satellite orbit (necessary for the mechanics of the Space Station)
*) Added effects after the destruction of stones
*) Added effects to the construction of the Research Station
*) Added display of units in the world window
*) Added a starting scene with a trailer
*) Added an indicator of the energy consumption of the unit to the inventory
*) Added information about energy consumption or production to the Wikipedia for buildings
*) Added the content Empty on the Resource Analysis panel in the world window
*) Added the ability to move a building that has not yet been built
*) For the Scanning Station, the state - Technology is not researched in the Buildings window
*) Added display of the Energy Cell charge on the tool icon
*) Added - now buildings that have been placed but not built yet will change color when you hover over them
*) Now the energy charge of tools will be gradually spent

Fixed:
*) Fixed the problem when Wikipedia did not open in the inventory by pressing F1
*) Fixed a bug when in the settings on the Antialiasing slot it always showed Off
*) Fixed the problem when the sound was completely turned off and after turning it on there was still no sound until you click Apply
*) Fixed the problem when it was impossible to exit the unit's inventory by pressing Esc or I
*) Fixed Pause and Resume the game by pressing the Space key

*) Fixed a bug where the Component Factory could take resources from the Resource Cleaning Station that it was currently using

*) Fixed a bug where when quickly transferring items from a virtual container to the construction inventory, the cells in the unit's inventory were freed up, after which the new items overlapped each other

notes.title: Update v.0.2.991 (22.12.2023)
notes.notes:
​​​​​​​Happy upcoming holidays!

Update v.0.2.991

Changes:
1) The size of the Disassembly window has been adjusted
2) Now when you close the Building window, the Disassembly window will also closed
3) The dawn in the game has been slightly shifted. Now dawn will be at 6:20, previously it was at 7:10 (required for the correct operation of the unit’s flashlight functionality)
4) The appearance of the panel for resource mining and destruction of buildings has been changed. Added maximum indicator and name of the current process
5) The number of technologies displayed has been increased to 6 in the Technology inspect window (previously there were 2)
6) Increased the processing time of all ores by 50%. This change is necessary because New technologies will soon be introduced to improve these indicators
7) Optimization has been carried out with updating the item texts. Previously, the text was updated for all items after each operation of splitting, movement, etc.
8) The preset selection window in the Constructor window has been optimized. Now presets load even faster
9) The logic for processing resources has been adjusted. The minimum amount of resources that can be obtained after clearing is now 1 (previously it was possible to get 0), and the maximum will be in the range from 1 to max
10) Increased the time of spilling resources from Barrels by 2 times
11) Now, after spilling Barrels with resources, an Empty Barrel will be created in their place (provided that the resource has been completely removed from the barrel)
12) The creation of items in the inventory of the Trading floor has been optimized. When switching between traders, items will be placed in the buffer and retrieved from there as needed
13) Now, when dragging items in the inventory, containers that have free space will be highlighted
14) Now the Virtual container button will be highlighted when there are items in it
15) Changed the base storage size of the Power collector station building from 4x2 to 4x3 (since it was impossible to remove the building’s Energy Cell from the charging slots)
16) Now, when dragging building modules in the Building window, the module slots to which this module can be attached will be highlighted, provided that it is compatible with the building
17) The production time of all components has been increased by 2 times. This change is necessary because New technologies will soon be introduced to improve these indicators

Added:
1) Added a new item - Geodata
2) Added the ability to add a unit to the queue for resource extraction, provided that the unit is currently extracting one of the resources (stone, wood).
To do this, call the context menu on the desired resource and select Add to queue. The unit must be selected!
3) For the Surface scanning station, a new panel has been added to the Building window, which displays all resource deposits that are nearby
4) A flashlight has been added to units; it will automatically turn on at night and turn off with the first rays of the Sun.
This mechanic is attached to the Device module. The power consumption of the flashlight is still the same for everyone - 5% of the base consumption (0.2 kW)
5) Now Devices (modules for units) can carry the functionality of a Flashlight, this characteristic will be generated randomly
6) You can now add an item to your favorites in the unit's inventory. To add an item to your favorites, it must belong to a unit
Selected items cannot be automatically transferred to a building or anywhere else (for example, through the Unload all to building action). The functionality will expand!
7) The Drilling section has been added to the Water converter in the Building window. Now mining can be paused
8) Now Energy Cells can be dragged and attached to charging slots in the Building window
9) The Resource Barrel item has a numeric display of its contents added
10) For the Thermal Power Plant, a tooltip about the lack of fuel in the inventory has been added
11) Now, when Buried Containers are discovered, they will be displayed on the minimap and on the global map

Corrected:
1) Fixed an issue where the tooltip on resource deposits did not appear
2) Fixed an error in sending technology for research. An error occurred when a player quickly submitted and canceled research on one technology
3) Fixed an issue where, while placing a building, it was possible to Focus on the building through the Building window
4) Now after disassembling an item, its components will spawn correctly in the building’s inventory
5) Fixed a bug when dragging the Back or Front trunk the corresponding slot in the unit’s inventory was not highlighted
6) Wikipedia - fixed a problem where when you clicked the Open wiki button in the Cleaning or Producing components section, nothing happened
7) Fixed a bug where a tooltip on vegetation could appear when the cursor was in the mini-map area
8) Fixed a bug when the tool icon remained active after deactivating the tool
9) Fixed an issue where it was impossible to enter the number of components produced through the Confirmation window, the input field did not work correctly
10) Fixed an issue where the Spilling Station did not spill the barrels, but removed them from inventory
11) Fixed a problem where, during the activity of the Research Collector task, the player could research any other available technology, while losing the opportunity to research the required technology
12) Fixed a bug when, in the Power Scanning mode, the value of Energy Consumption for buildings remained marked in red, although there was electricity in the web
13) Fixed a bug when, after moving from the slots of a unit’s module to an unopened container (for example, moving the Device to the Back trunk, which is in the unit’s inventory), it saved the state of the module attached to the unit
14) Fixed a bug when, after installing a module to expand the storage of a building, the unit’s inventory area also changed (became smaller, which made it difficult to access all items in the Back trunk)
15) Fixed a problem when in the Building window it was possible to remove some modules from a unit that required a special tool
16) Fixed a problem where in the Item Inspect Window, when scrolling through information about an item using LMB, without releasing the LMB, it was possible to rotate the item in the Preview panel
17) Fixed a bug when in the Constructor some scene objects were visible through the icons
18) An attempt was made to fix the error when a black screen appeared when the game was launched (if this problem occurs, report it to the developer, do not forget to send .log files)
19) Fixed a bug when the icon of resource deposits on the global map was displayed incorrectly (showed None)
20) Fixed a problem where components were not created when disassembling a building module

notes.title: Update v.0.2.576
notes.notes:
v.0.2.576 (11.11.2023)

https://sun9-49.userapi.com/impg/3n-j7mnaMhqkTQSDZzpskbR60XW52U06o7c1ng/ZmQ2c7AKxDE.jpg?size=800x450&quality=95&sign=9e2e339a341a54db5b1c1c8458edcb90&type=album

Changes:
1) Drones can now repair buildings. For this, the Technical Drone Station is used. Research the technology to activate it. (needs testing)
2) Reduced the size of the game save file (by an average of 40% by replacing the json format with bin (old saves will not work))
3) Localization and text, some edits
4) Game performance has been slightly increased by removing unnecessary operations to check whether the cursor enters the area of UI elements
5) The icon for sending technologies for research has been changed
6) Slightly improved elements of the Technologies window
7) Technologies Solar energy and Wind energy have been increased in price - another type of chip grant has been added
8) Now some commands in the context menu will be highlighted in colors (for example, Clear resource in the Sawmill)
9) Component Disassembly Window - now when dragging items, the icon in the Disassembly Window will be highlighted, indicating that the component can be disassembled
10) Component Disassembly Window - now after disassembly, items will be created directly in the unit’s inventory
11) Now the unit tooltip will take into account the resources located in the Front trunk
12) The logic of the Item Splitting window has been slightly changed - now when you click outside the window or separate an item, it will not close
13) Now, when you reopen the Building Window, the unit panel will load even faster
14) Now items will display a short text of their quantity (for example, 1000 => 1k)
15) Highlighted slots in a unit’s inventory have become even brighter

Added:
1) Durability indicator has been added to the Building Window
2) Component Disassembly Window - you can now drag a component into the Disassembly Window
3) Item Splitting Window - you can now drag an item into the Item Splitting Window
4) Technology slot - added display of required components on the slot itself in the form of small indicators
5) Technology tree - a new panel has been added to the technology overview panel, which duplicates technologies for opening this technology
6) Technology tree - a new research branch has been added - Technical Drone Station
7) For mining buildings in the Building Window, an indicator of the extraction time of one resource in seconds has been added
8) Trade - added a button "Remove all resources from the cargo shuttle"
9) Trade, item tooltips - an indicator of the trader’s percentage markup for this component has been added to the price
10) An indicator for transporting the Cargo Shuttle for the Trade has been added to the Building Overview Window
11) Wikipedia - new technologies added

Fixed:
1) Fixed a problem where, during a Pause of the game, the Information panels in the Inventory window were not deleted and remained active
2) Lots of minor UI fixes
3) A small optimization of the building placement grid has been carried out
4) Fixed a bug when, after laying a cable web, an indicator remained on it indicating that the web was not connected to the building
5) Fixed a bug when resources were duplicated in the Conveyor web overview window
6) Fixed the problem of incorrect positioning of the context menu on the reader
7) Fixed an issue where it was impossible to move the camera while the Item Splitting panel was active
8) Fixed a bug where the Unit Dialog Panel would jerk when appearing

OLD saves will not work correctly. Sorry for the inconvenience! :(

notes.title: Update v.0.2.331 (07/20/2023)
notes.notes:
v.0.2.331 (07/20/2023)

Changes:
1) Technology research result icons have been replaced in the technology pop-up window
2) In building tooltips, the location of indicators for the consumption of liquids has been changed (for example, Water Power Plant). Now it is displayed in an intuitive way (maximum quantity/current quantity).
3) Now on the location map at the maximum distance, the icons of buildings will be replaced by white squares (for optimization purposes)
4) Technical Drone Station - now the station will send all free drones to containers to collect resources after the destruction of buildings
5) Now the maximum charge of units' Energy Cells will slowly decrease. Charge degradation occurs, and the maximum capacity will decrease. Recovery is not subject.
6) Reduced by 2 times the default number of drone slots for buildings - Technical Drone Station, Drone Factory, Crusher, Sawmill
7) Localization and text, some edits
8) Drones must now be present at the Sawmill to plant vegetation
9) Now the icons of pipelines in the Building Window will be divided into Input and Output
10) Technical Drone Station - service area reduced from 45 units to 40 units 

Added:
1) Trading floor - an indicator has been added to the slots of the queue, which indicates which process the slot belongs to (sale or purchase)
2) Location map - on the icons of buildings, the display of the components or resources that they produce at the moment has been added
3) Technical Drone Station - functionality of work priorities for drones has been added. By default - construction, repair (not yet available) collection of resources. If you set the value to [-1], the operation of this complex will be suspended.
4) Added the functionality of Disassemble complex components and modules. To open the Disassembly Window, call the context menu on the component you want to disassemble, and then click the Disassemble button. Or use the shortcut button located under the Back Trunk icon in the unit's inventory next to the Sort Items button.
There will be a small penalty when disassembling the components. This means that you will receive fewer resources than when you create it. This fine may be reduced in the near future.
The disassembly window has 6x6 cells, in which resources will be created after the component is disassembled. You cannot place other items in this window, you can only pick it up! If a resource does not stack during disassembly, then it will be created in the amount of 1 pc.
5) Added a button to call the Disassembly window. Found next to the Sort Items button in the Back Trunk

Corrected:
1) Fixed a problem with the reverse timer of traders, when they turned yellow with a large amount of time left
2) Fixed a problem with the loud sound of the Drone Factory
3) Technical Drone Station - fixed a bug when not all drones were sent to build buildings
4) Technical Drone Station - fixed a bug when drones did not take resources from containers
5) Technical Drone Station - fixed an issue where the drone would disappear when approaching a container that was close to the Technical Drone Station
6) Technical Drone Station - fixed the problem when the drone could not go to the building in order to transfer the required amount of resources to the building. The building already had a certain amount of resources, so the drone could not collect the required amount.
7) Trading floor - fixed a bug when the total cost of the items could become negative
8) Trading floor - fixed a bug when the resource icon was white in the buy window
9) Location map - fixed a problem when, at the maximum distance, no tooltips were created on the icons of buildings when hovering over
10) Location map - fixed a problem when, at the maximum distance, the icons of buildings did not change to white squares (to optimize performance)
11) Planting Vegetation - fixed a problem when new trees were not added to the list for production in the Sawmill if they fell into the Mining area
12) Location map - fixed a bug when a resource icon (Stone) appeared on all building icons
13) Location map - fixed a problem when the icons of buildings had an incorrect orientation after the building was rotated
14) Fixed a bug - when trying to move non-stackable items from a unit's inventory to a building (or vice versa) using the [Shift] key pressed, the items created their copies, after which the inventory hung

notes.title: Update v.0.1.976 (04/10/2023)
notes.notes:
v.0.1.976 (04/10/2023)

Changes:
1) Localization and text, some edits

Added:
1) Wikipedia - statistics added to drones
2) Item Inspect Window - in the production and cleaning section, an icon of the building in which the item is produced has been added
3) Trading - an indicator has been added to the sell and buy window, indicating that the player or merchant does not have enough funds to buy or sell
4) Two new switches have been added to the location map - Show unit icons and Show building icons
5) Added the weather coefficient of destruction (aging) of objects on the location, such as units, buildings, etc. Previously, only temperature affected the aging of objects.
6) A new technology has been added - Planting Vegetation. The technology is in the General section. It gives access to the vegetation planting interface on the map. Now you can restore the forest even faster.
7) Added new game mechanics - Planting Vegetation. It is available at the Sawmill buildings after researching the relevant technology. The switch is in the Building Window, Settings section. Testing required!

Fixed:
1) Wikipedia - fixed incorrect display of the building in which barrels with resources are produced (was the Component Factory, it became the Spilling Station)
2) Fixed the problem of not displaying the rock on the mini map and location map
3) Fixed a bug when after canceling the placement of a building (with the Dronatization tool turned on), the scene remained bright, even in the dark time
4) Fixed the problem when placing a building in Grid mode, the Dronetization tool was activated, then deactivated, after which the Grid mode was not restored

notes.title: Update v.0.1.524 (02.14.2023)
notes.notes:
v.0.1.524 (02.14.2023)

Changes:
1) Now, when placing the buildings Hydrowell, Wind Power Plants, Drilling Station of Solid Resources, Wind, Water or Stone maps will automatically turn on, depending on the type of buildings
2) In the Grid mode, the size of the docking elements for buildings has been increased by 2 times
3) Some buildings have revised electricity consumption in a calm state
4) Changed the starting set of resources in the Launch Shuttle
5) The recipe for the Component Factory has been changed. Removed ores from the recipe and replaced them with the appropriate ingots
6) Now, when you enter the Grid mode, the functionality for placing grid elements will automatically turn on
7) Increased the brightness of the projections that show the range of some buildings
8) Localization and text, some edits
9) The energy indicator of the logs has been increased from 9.3 to 10.5 kW
10) Changed inventory size of Power Collector Station from 3x3 to 4x2
 cells
11) Now the unit's statistics will be updated in the constructor depending on the modules attached to it

Added:
1) Added special text when placing some buildings, which explains where it is better to place the building. The text is located in the construction window
2) Added a battery indicator to the tooltip when hovering over a unit
3) The function to isolate the Power Collector Station from the web has been added, the switch is located in the Building Window in the settings section. Prohibit the building from giving electricity to the web. The building will still receive electricity from the grid. By default, the option is disabled.
4) In the game settings, a switch has been added to select the monitor on which the picture will be displayed. Need testing!
5) Wikipedia added statistics to resources, components and modules
6) Added a hint indicating that the object is outside the location and cannot be reached by the unit

8) Added statistics to the tooltips of the module (Speed, Angular speed, etc.)

Corrected:
1) Fixed a bug when in the Building window (when the Building Controls window is open) resources were not removed from the building inventory when auto-clearing ores in the Ore Clearing Station.
2) Fixed a bug when Wikipedia did not open after exiting the modding mode
3) Fixed a bug when the Liquid/Gas Clearing Station consumed a large amount of energy when idle
4) Fixed a bug when, after exiting to the main menu, the rain sound did not stop

notes.title: Update v.0.1.476 (02.07.2023) Bug fixes
notes.notes:
